svg.title: Post-quantum is decided twice: offered by the client, chosen by the server
svg.text: Decided twice: the client has to offer it, the server has to choose it.
offered: a list of groups, versions, signature algorithms
the certificate: encrypted in TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446 §4.4.2), so it never shows on the wire
an inventory that sees only one side cannot say which side is the obstacle
Zeek on a copy of every frame; nothing is sent
both sides of every real handshake,
across the whole estate at once,
a targeted scan of one listener
testssl.sh, ssh-audit and the paired probes: it asks
and key, what it still accepts after a change
which accepted options are ever used
